caption:
For two people who love each other

Ibn Abbas narrated that the Prophet ﷺ said there is nothing like marriage for two who love one another. Make dua tonight for your spouse, or for the one Allah has written for you.

Sunan Ibn Majah 1847 · Grade: Sahih
